'''Mike Kimosh''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Durham tournament]] on 15 July 2001, according to Edwin Harris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2637">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-durham-nc-7-15d2637/ durham-nc-7-15], DeckTech (Edwin "Edwin" Harris, 15 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-durham-nc-7-15d2637/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
